title: Systems: how the game works
summary: Controls and the map, the party, trading, falling in a fight, the options and the profile card: the systems every awakened uses.

blocks.text: Controls and the map : every key (keyboard and gamepad) and the map of each place. Party : up to 4 awakened together, on any server, and how the XP is shared. Trading : swapping items and shards with another awakened. Falling: lives and revives : what happens when you fall, in the city, in a dungeon and in the tower. Options : graphics, sound, interface, controls, privacy. Transit network : 25 kiosks to travel anywhere in the city, free and instant. Traveling merchant : a new merchant every 30 minutes, the same on every server. Runes and stars : runes engraved into your gear, and stars for +4% stats in dungeons. Profile card : what the others see of you, and what you can hide.
